title: Home Power Plan
sub: 3 days a week, about 25 minutes, no equipment.

items: Explode up, land soft and quiet, reset between reps.
Jump for distance and stick the landing.
Push hard enough that your hands leave the floor, or as fast as you can.
Push the wall like you're trying to move it.
Rear straight driven from the back foot through the hip.
30 s hard combos, 30 s burpees, repeat. Effort 8 to 9 out of 10.
Easy skipping or jog in place
Pace where you can still talk in short phrases.
